svg.title: There is a further conclusion about the mean Euclidean hierarchy. Its scale parameter is the same weak sequence rk →0, with ultraviolet inverse scale r−1 k ; it does not assert interpolation to every small positive real scale. Let E0 d be the free Maxwell field spaces and Uk,d : E0 d →Ed the simultaneous scaling frames.
